title: Intermediate Software Developer
body:
Brightquay Software builds scheduling tools for New Zealand ports and logistics teams. We're looking for an Intermediate Software Developer to join our product team in Wellington. This is a permanent, full-time role with hybrid working.

What you'll do
• Build and maintain features across our React front end and Node.js services
• Write clean, tested TypeScript and review pull requests
• Work with designers and product managers to ship improvements every sprint

What you'll bring
• 3+ years of commercial software development experience
• Strong skills in TypeScript, React, Node.js, AWS and Git
• Good communication skills and a collaborative approach

Nice to have:
• PostgreSQL
• Docker

Visa
We are an accredited employer and can support an Accredited Employer Work Visa for the right candidate.

How to apply
Please send your CV and a cover letter telling us about a project you're proud of.
